token: An ATP token issued only against a verified metered kWh certificate.
An ATP token minted against a forecast energy credit that has not yet been metered.
A token redemption that burns the certificate and issues the corresponding energy record.
A token issued with a fractional reserve >1.0x against a single reused certificate (double-mint).
A token transfer recorded to the ledger and the certificate custody updated atomically.
A token batch minted before the grid's Renewable Attribute Certificate was retired.
A token whose issuance is transparently audited to the metered source via signed provenance.
A token sold as 'solar' but backed by a non-renewable grid-mix credit.
A token that is redeemable for a verified kWh credit which is then retired from circulation.
A token whose backing certificate lapsed beyond the redemption window but was still redeemed.
